authority.notes: Compatibility mode: this graph governs only AO-* migration work. Product/game work remains selected from docs/content-roadmap.md until an explicit cutover phase is verified.

tasks.title: Establish machine-readable task graph foundation
acceptance: A versioned task-graph schema and migration graph are committed without changing product-roadmap authority.
Repository-local validation rejects duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, dependency cycles, invalid active/ready states, and malformed proof metadata.
A deterministic next-task selector honors active work, dependencies, and priority.
A focused CI workflow validates the orchestration foundation when its files change.
AGENTS.md documents the compatibility boundary so P28 selection behavior is unchanged.

proofs.description: Task graph validator and selector regression tests pass.
The repository graph validates and the selector resolves AO-1 deterministically.
Agent Orchestration CI passes on the exact candidate revision.
docs/content-roadmap.md remains authoritative for product/game task selection during compatibility mode.

tasks.title: Add roadmap compatibility adapter and sidecar task metadata
acceptance: Active roadmap items can be represented in the graph without manually duplicating their acceptance text.
Roadmap order remains authoritative while dependency and proof metadata become machine-readable.
Drift between roadmap IDs and graph metadata fails validation.

proofs.description: Roadmap parsing, graph materialization, ID/order matching, sync behavior, and drift detection tests pass.
The active Markdown roadmap and sidecar are synchronized and materialize into a valid product task graph.
Agent Orchestration CI passes the roadmap adapter and drift checks on the exact candidate revision.

tasks.title: Add change-impact and affected-verification selection
acceptance: Changed files map to affected domains and focused verification commands.
Unknown or high-risk impact expands verification rather than silently under-testing.
Selection output is deterministic and machine-readable.

proofs.description: Impact-map validation, glob matching, deterministic selection, escalation, and de-duplication regressions pass.
The repository impact map validates and representative P28 graphics changes resolve to machine-readable targeted checks.
Agent Orchestration CI passes the affected-verification map, representative selector run, and regressions on the exact candidate revision.

tasks.title: Add exact-candidate manifest and verification ledger
acceptance: Final candidates record task ID, base/head SHA, changed files, required proofs, CI evidence, artifact identity, and unresolved external QA.
Verification evidence cannot be credited to a different candidate SHA.
Future agents can read compact proof records instead of reconstructing completion from PR history.

proofs.description: Candidate-manifest and verification-ledger integrity regressions reject cross-SHA evidence and manifest tampering.
The active AO task can generate and strictly validate a manifest and ledger from the exact PR base/head candidate.
Agent Orchestration CI checks out the exact PR head SHA and publishes a validated candidate manifest plus verification ledger artifact for the successful candidate.

tasks.title: Deduplicate final verification and reuse candidate artifacts
acceptance: Expensive full-repository verification runs once for the exact final candidate unless evidence requires a rerun.
Browser and Android validation consume reusable outputs from the same candidate where technically safe.
Focused iteration remains fast while final release confidence is preserved.

proofs.description: Candidate web artifact identity and integrity regressions reject wrong-SHA or modified bundles.
PR orchestration contains exactly one full-repository verification/production-build producer for the candidate web bundle.
Desktop and mobile browser validation consume the same exact-SHA candidate web artifact instead of rebuilding it.
Android packaging consumes the same exact-SHA candidate web artifact and Android emulator jobs reuse the resulting APK artifact.

tasks.title: Add mandatory independent review and mechanical architecture proofs
acceptance: Final candidates support a separate read-only verifier context that attempts to disprove completion without creating a competing implementation.
Final PR verification requires an actual trusted independent-review pass result bound to the exact current candidate SHA; missing, stale, malformed, or failed review evidence blocks completion.
When no orchestration migration task is active, the independent-review packet automatically targets the first executable product-roadmap task so the gate remains useful after AO-6 is complete.
Stable architectural invariants are mechanically checked where practical, and recurring deterministic failure classes can be promoted into reusable repository checks or telemetry.

proofs.description: Mechanical architecture boundaries and their fail-closed regressions pass on the candidate.
Independent review packet/result, trusted-comment selection, stale-SHA rejection, and workflow-gate regressions pass.
A separate verifier returns a validated pass result for this exact candidate SHA after attempting to falsify every acceptance criterion and required proof.
Agent Orchestration and PR Candidate Verification pass on the same exact candidate revision with the review gate enforced.

tasks.title: Extend trusted independent review to experimental promotions
acceptance: Trusted-main review request parsing and exact-candidate packet resolution support EV-* promotion tasks without executing candidate-authored verifier code.
When no AO task is active or closing, ordinary candidates still fall back to the first executable product-roadmap task exactly as AO-6 requires.
Experimental task resolution derives the first EV promotion or a single-item closeout from the exact head/base experimental roadmap and fails closed on combined or reordered removals.
Trusted-review self-tests cover EV request namespaces, experimental active/closeout selection, unsupported task namespaces, and fail-closed combined closeout behavior.

proofs.description: Trusted review request parsing plus exact EV active/closeout packet regressions pass.
AO-6 product-roadmap fallback remains unchanged whenever no AO task is active or closing.
A separate trusted verifier returns a validated pass for the exact AO-7 candidate SHA after falsification attempts.
Agent Orchestration and PR Candidate Verification pass on the exact AO-7 candidate revision with the review gate enforced.

tasks.title: Bootstrap trusted EV-9 exact-head observer
acceptance: A pull_request_target observer executes only exact-base checked-out trusted code while reading the PR head's PR Candidate workflow as untrusted Git data; it never checks out or executes candidate code.

The trusted observer directly verifies the PR Candidate exact-head producer, runtime candidate output, exact-SHA review/browser/Android consumers, final evidence checkout, and rejects synthetic checkout refs.

Trusted observer self-tests include a behavior-preserving control plus producer-ref, candidate-output, downstream-SHA, final-ref, and downstream consumer-semantic attacks with zero false positives and zero false negatives, and Agent Orchestration exposes that self-test as exact-SHA proof.
This prerequisite only lands the base-controlled trust mechanism and its proof. EV-9's live enforcement integration remains on PR #368 and begins only after this bootstrap is merged to trusted main.

AO-8 uses the repository's introduced-verified closeout representation so the trusted reviewer targets this bootstrap; the final candidate gate remains authoritative and the bootstrap must not merge without its exact-SHA review pass.

proofs.description: Agent Orchestration runs the trusted EV-9 observer parser and attack calibration self-test on the exact candidate SHA.
Mechanical architecture and independent-review contracts continue to pass for the bootstrap candidate.
A separate trusted verifier returns a validated pass for the exact AO-8 bootstrap candidate SHA.
Agent Orchestration and PR Candidate Verification pass on the exact AO-8 bootstrap candidate revision; the PR Candidate final job may be rerun after the trusted verdict is published.

tasks.title: Permit trusted EV-9 live integration boundary
acceptance: The trusted exact-head observer permits candidate changes only to the fixed EV-9 evidence-independence implementation file set while continuing to pin unrelated agent helpers to trusted base objects.

If any permitted EV-9 implementation file changes, PR Candidate Verification must contain the exact three-step EV-9 regression, enforcement, and evidence-upload block immediately after the source-bound candidate web artifact is published.

The trusted observer rejects EV-9 integration before artifact publication, a neutralized promotion gate, and unrelated agent-helper mutation while preserving all AO-8 exact-head, consumer, review, and final-evidence checks.

This compatibility bootstrap changes only the trusted observer boundary; EV-9 policy, graph, enforcement implementation, archive transition, and live workflow integration remain exclusively on PR #368.

AO-9 uses the repository's introduced-verified closeout representation so the trusted reviewer targets this prerequisite; it must not merge without exact-SHA technical proof and independent-review pass.

proofs.description: Agent Orchestration runs the trusted EV-9 observer self-test including live-integration ordering and agent-file allowlist attacks on the exact candidate SHA.
Mechanical architecture and independent-review contracts continue to pass for the compatibility bootstrap.
A separate trusted verifier returns a validated pass for the exact AO-9 compatibility candidate SHA.
Agent Orchestration, EV-9 trusted observer self-test, and PR Candidate Verification pass on the exact AO-9 candidate; the final candidate job may be rerun after the trusted verdict is published.
